name: Draenei and Blood Elves reaching level 20 are mailed a reachable riding pamphlet (#6586)
contract: mail_level_reward (20, 1024) mailed Draenei template 227 from Aalun 20914: pamphlet 46879 starts Learn to Ride at
the Exodar 14082. (20, 512) mailed Blood Elves template 232 from Perascamin 16280: pamphlet 46882 starts Learn to
Ride in the Eversong Woods 14081. Both trainers stand on map 530, which a Classic account cannot enter, and both
races now start on the old continents (rev_20261003_30). Expected: a Draenei reaching level 20 gets the Night Elf
pamphlet 46876 (template 225, Jartsam 4753, Darnassus) and no 46879; a Blood Elf gets the Undead pamphlet 46881
(template 233, Velma Warnam 4773, Brill) and no 46882. Quests 14085 and 14089 take every race, and trainers 40
and 41 have no race requirement. The mailbox UI is not tested.
